name: print-social-infographic-yellow-retro-three-column
title: Yellow retro three-column social media infographic
whatItIs: A yellow infographic split into three numbered speech-bubble columns, each combining a flat retro icon, colored progress/percentage bars, and a world map with a bar chart beneath.
whatItMeans: Retro flat icons and a warm yellow/teal palette give data a friendly, approachable tone that softens what could otherwise be a dry statistics dump.
techniques: organize a wide infographic into three clearly numbered vertical sections
use speech-bubble shapes as section headers to imply 'talking points'
apply a consistent retro flat-icon style across otherwise varied chart types for cohesion

vocabulary.definition: a horizontal bar visually representing a percentage or completion value
